name: Falling Down
overview: Scripture reveals that falling down can express reverence and worship, as seen when Joshua and the disciples fell on their faces in awe before God’s presence (Joshua 5:14; Matthew 17:6). It also illustrates human frailty and perseverance, with the righteous experiencing many trials yet rising again each time they fall (Proverbs 24:16; Psalms 34:19). Even Christ Himself fell on His face in prayer, submitting to the Father’s will despite the weight of suffering (Matthew 26:39), demonstrating humble dependence on God amid hardship.
